name: kitchensink4ppt
description: Lets Claude build and edit PowerPoint decks for you: slides, text, real vector diagrams, tables, charts, and speaker notes.
long_description: KitchenSink4PPT connects Claude to your presentations. Ask it to build slides, draw diagrams from real shapes you can still move, fill tables, or fix a deck due in the morning. Every change lands after an automatic backup and the work is checked when it saves. The server runs on your computer and KitchenSink4AI never receives your decks; your AI app handles what the server reads under its own settings. Part of the KitchenSink4 family (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Web) from KitchenSink4AI (kitchensink4.ai). macOS is untested in this release.
